$comment: Every indexable, parameter-free public page (docs/seo-page-standard.md). One entry per non-noindex pattern in seo-routes.ts; scripts/indexable-pages.spec.ts fails when the two drift. Read by scripts/build-seo-artifacts.ts (sitemap), scripts/build-llms-txt.ts (llms.txt; the one-line summary is the page's own meta description from copy.seo) and tools/check-prerender-seo.mjs (prerender SEO check). jsonLd names the structured data the prerender check validates: 'faq' = FAQPage, 'guide' = @graph with Article + FAQPage. Community pages (/communities/{slug}/) are data-driven and come from community-aggregates.json instead.
